issue_request: FHIR-31679 was a Published FHIR-core vocab change request for the old LOINC data-elements mapping table. It asked to allow FHIR string for LOINC scale type Nar; the final Not Persuasive with Modification decision said markdown already covers string, so the intended change was to remove question-mark/parenthetical uncertainty from the Nar row and remove the parenthetical string question from the Nom row.

Its implementation commit 81e5862f203fdb8a03e9c943a7cf455aba8973f4 deleted source/loinc.html and updated source/terminologies-systems.html to link LOINC usage guidance to https://terminology.hl7.org/LOINC.html. Vocab minutes from 2021-08-11 confirm FHIR-31679 was resolved as a slightly modified change request, and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
